mapper.content:
PrimeStone Developments

Hello {{2.full_name}},

Thank you for reaching out regarding The Oak Residences, Lekki Phase 1. We have successfully received your inquiry and want to confirm that your allocation preference is temporarily flagged.

Our private desk has locked in your interest with the following registration details:

Reservation Registry

Preferred Unit: {{2.property_interest}}
Indicated Budget: ₦{{2.budget}}
Preferred Location: {{2.preferred_location}}

What happens next?

To make sure you secure Phase 1 entry-level pricing (before the scheduled adjustment), a dedicated PrimeStone investment partner will be calling you directly on {{2.phone}}.

  • Current Pricing Hold: Your Phase 1 pricing tier is securely locked for the next 72 hours.
  • Information Package: During our call, we will share the full subscription pack, certified escrow terms, and exact structural blueprints for your unit.
  • Tailored Payment: We are prepared to structure an 18-month payment plan specifically designed around your project milestones.

If you would like to fast-track your inquiry or connect directly with our sales suite on WhatsApp, please use the secure link below:

Connect on WhatsApp Instantly

Warm regards,
The Private Desk
PrimeStone Developments

PrimeStone Developments Ltd

14B Admiralty Way, Lekki Phase 1, Lagos, Nigeria

Contact Desk: +234 811 132 005 4 | sales@primestonedevelopments.com

This confirmation of interest does not constitute a financial subscription. Your data is securely held and is never shared outside PrimeStone Developments partners.
